- [USER] User mentioned "Apkallu."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained the Apkallu, also known as the Seven Sages of Sumer, as legendary beings from ancient Mesopotamian mythology.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The term "Apkallu" means "wise men" or "sages" in Akkadian.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Apkallu were sent by the gods to teach humans various skills, depicted as half-human, half-fish creatures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] They were believed to communicate with the gods and were revered for their wisdom and knowledge.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Apkallu were said to have played a role in the creation of humans and were credited with healing and warding off evil spirits.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The legacy of the Apkallu can be seen in ancient Sumerian and Akkadian artworks and artifacts.
